description: Read the x402 market price band: what paid x402 services list per call in public x402 discovery catalogs, as the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile price per call for each category and over every category, with how many services stand behind each band and the day it describes. Pass category to narrow to one, and days with it for that band per day. Use it to see what a paid call usually costs before you pay; verify_price and check_purchase use the same band. List prices only, never evidence of demand: some sellers pay themselves. Public: needs no credential, limited per address. Until it is switched on it answers not released.

category.description: Only this category, with the overall band. Leave out for every category.

days.description: With category: also that band for each of the last this many days.

name: get_x402_price_index
